text:
alex_lee: Heads up — pool13/card9 is showing an accelerated memory-fault trend since ~02:00 UTC. Page retirement events up ~3x, Xid logs and ECC corrected counts climbing. Anyone on-call?

jamie_w: I noticed the spike on the infra dashboards at 02:12. remap_count jumped from ~4/hr to ~13/hr. NVML shows ECC corrected on GPU 9 went from 12 -> 78 in the last 6h. :eyes:

priya: pasting relevant dmesg snippet I pulled a minute ago: ```[2467.123456] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, pid=12345, GPU 0000:3b:00.0, GPU has been reset```. Also saw repeated page retire log lines with addresses in the same region.

sam: I'm starting a cordon/drain for node gpu-13-09 now, migrating running jobs off. Will tag node as `needs-hw-review`.

alex_lee: good. priority = P2 for now but escalate if remap_count keeps climbing. @priya can you run the nv-hostengine capture and upload the mem-errors bundle to /mnt/health-uploads?

priya: running `nv-hostengine collect --metrics mem-errors --since 12h` now. Uploading bundle to s3://redwood-health/pool13/gpu-9/1876543210.tar.gz when done.

tina_k: I kicked off a quick memtest on the node before the drain completed. Partial address range test failed intermittently. This looks like progressive physical degradation, not a one-off transient. I'm opening a hardware replacement ticket with vendor. vendor-oncall, assigning to you.

vendor-oncall: acknowledged. Received upload and logs, we'll triage. Initial read points to blocked remap pages and grow-in ECC corrections. ETA for remote replacement/dispatch is ~6h depending on local inventory.

infra-bot: Auto-alert generated: `page_retire_rate > threshold` for pool13/card9. Incident INC-2029-0456 created and linked.

jamie_w: short analysis: two patterns we see across previous failures — steady ECC correction growth preceding remap acceleration, and repeated Xid 79 resets. Given the history, prefer full card replacement vs soft page retire. Soft-retire often returns to degraded state within weeks.

priya: I'm scanning other GPUs in pool13 for similar signals: running `scripts/gpu_health_scan --pools 13 --since 48h`. Preliminary sweep flagged card11 (marginal) and card4 (normal). Will post full CSV in the incident.

sam: ops ask — can we reduce stress on remaining pool13 cards by lowering batch sizes or shifting new jobs to pool14 until replacement?

alex_lee: yes. @ops-team please throttle new allocations to pool13, lower default batch by 25% for existing job templates, and prefer pool14 for new work.

tina_k: created HW ticket RESERVE-847 with vendor, included NVML logs, dmesg, memtest output, and the host drain timeline. Marked for next-day swap if on-site not available tonight.

jamie_w: after drain finished, migrations completed without OOMs. Node is cordoned (`k8s: cordon gpu-13-09`). Keeping cordon until vendor confirms.

priya: uploaded full scan results and a short timeline to the incident: s3://redwood-health/pool13/gpu-9/1876543210-report.csv. Adding watchlist for pool13 with alert sensitivity bumped for remap_count.

alex_lee: thanks. Action items: 1) vendor replacement ticket (tina_k) 2) ops throttle/reroute (sam + ops-team) 3) increase remap alert sensitivity for pool13 (priya) 4) post-incident summary to #incidents once vendor confirms schedule (alex_lee).

vendor-oncall: we'll update INC-2029-0456 when replacement slot is booked. If remote reflash/testing clears it, we'll advise; otherwise swap.

jamie_w: +1 to replacement. Long tail of partial fixes is costing us scheduling churn.

alex_lee: posting brief note here so SRE/product knows possible capacity hit on pool13 for the next 12h. Will update if vendor shortens ETA. :shipit:

priya: will keep watch and ping if remap_count crosses a hard threshold again.

infra-bot: Reminder: incident INC-2029-0456 escalated to oncall ops at 1876543300.

sam: leaving node cordoned and deallocated from autoscale for now. If vendor gives green light for remote tests, I'll run them during maintenance window.

tina_k: logging this as a candidate for early replacement in the quarterly HW-refresh list — pattern matches other units we replaced last quarter.

alex_lee: thanks everyone. I'll sync with product about temporary capacity routing and follow up in ~2h. :thumbsup:
